Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MSFT.
Our cloud segment grew 18% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 18% to 6% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
We delivered record revenue of $29.8 billion this quarter, representing 18% year-over-year growth.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.

How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
